source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (December 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

**The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:** 

- Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.

- Handling change requests to competitions.

- Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2019.1.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)
<!-- break -->
**The qualities of members we are seeking include:**

- A sense of detail.

- Service mindedness to help delegates in all the requests they can have.

- Responsiveness in day to day communication with the rest of the Team and the Delegates.

- Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)

- Familiarity with the Regulations and WCA Policies.

- Good level of English.

Other qualities which are good to have:

- Having experience with competition organization and with group work. 

- Speaking more than one language.

- Coding Experience

The expected workload is around 8 hours per week. 


**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

- A brief personal introduction.

- Summary of activities done for the WCA.

- Goals as a member and why you are seeking to join.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **January 5th 2020 23:59 UTC** to Henrik Buus Aagaard ([haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org)).

Please pass this information on to anyone in your community that you believe would be a good fit for this new team. You do not need to have any current position inside the WCA to be considered.

Thank you!

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组成员招募（2019 年 12 月）
translation.content:
WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）正在招募新成员，帮助团队完成工作！申请向所有人开放，也欢迎目前未在 WCA 担任职务的社区成员申请。

**WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：**

- 审核提交的比赛申请，确保信息准确无误后公示比赛。
- 处理比赛信息变更申请。
- 与团队其他成员讨论并投票。

WCAT 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 动议 10.2019.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。

**我们希望新成员具备以下条件：**

- 注重细节。
- 有服务意识，愿意协助代表处理各类请求。
- 在与团队其他成员及代表的日常沟通中及时回应。
- 熟悉 [WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)。
- 熟悉竞赛规则及 WCA 政策。
- 良好的英语水平。

具备以下条件更佳：

- 有比赛组织和团队协作经验。
- 掌握不止一种语言。
- 有编程经验。

预计每周需投入约 8 小时。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 成为成员后的目标，以及申请加入的原因。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 **2020 年 1 月 5 日 23:59 UTC**。请将材料发送给 Henrik Buus Aagaard（[haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

如果你认为社区中有人适合这个新团队，请把消息转告他们。申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

谢谢！
